text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Kitasan Black has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um, there's something I wanna
ask!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've really pushed myself these past
three years,
haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod since it's true. She's committed an

unfathomable amount of effort into
training, and
the results speak for
themselves.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you really did work hard.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I was just thinking, since I've

accomplished so much and am usually so
hard on
myself, that it'd be nice to treat
myself too! So...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How about we go on a hot spring
vacation with
that ticket we won at the
raffle a while back?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you think it's bad for me to get carried
away
and have too much fun, I can hold
a concert at
the hot spring and call it
work!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on a great show for all the visitors
there,
so please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop Kitasan Black from seriously
planning a
concert, and we make it a
normal trip to the hot
spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. The water felt so good... My skin
and heart
feel so silky smooth...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Man, Trainer, hot springs sure are
dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I usually always stay sharp and focused,
but
soaking in there really puts down my
guard... For
some reason, I just...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna let loose today! I wanna be
just like a
kid again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the pressure of being a dependable
helper to
everyone must be getting to
her, which is why
she's craving a break so
badly.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Is it okay if I do as I like, Trainer? Just
for today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want other people to see me
slacking
off, but you're different, so I
don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Thank you! Don't judge me too
harshly for
being a little lazy, okay?
choice_data_list: Yeah, sure. Make yourself at home.
Yeah, sure. Spend your time however you like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kitasan Black metaphorically
lets down
her hair and enjoys herself to
her heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer... I-I stayed in the bath too
long... The
spin is worlding...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know that game where you count
down from
1,000? I played it by
myself... Uuurgh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly grab a cold towel and place it
on her
forehead. After that...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew! Shouldn't have eaten that last
one... I've
always held back during meals
so I can run
without issue, but this was
just too good...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! They've got desserts, too!
I'm
really craving a Japanese-style
dessert!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anything goes today, right? Can I order
some?
You gave me permission to go all
out earlier,
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Here I go, then! I'll have the shaved
ice with
green tea syrup and red beans,
topped with
condensed milk and extra
sweet dumplings!
choice_data_list: Sure, just don't collapse on me.
Sure, just make sure you don't collapse, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black continues to indulge on
her every
whim...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs are just the best! I feel so
satisfied
right now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't usually let loose like this, but maybe this is the real me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Trainer, why don't we do a
festival
dance right now?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I only ever get to do Western
style dances
on stage, so I really miss
doing traditional
Japanese ones.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please? Pretty please with a glazed
carrot on top!
I promise it'll be fun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! I knew you wouldn't let
me down.
Come on!
choice_data_list: Understood. I'm with you all the way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yoyoi no yoi! Yoyoi no yoi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black is usually reserved and
never asks
for anything, but she's like a
different person
today with how carefree
and exuberant she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Kitasan Black and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
